source: AAA gasprices.aaa.com national average — Memorial Day weekend carry-forward at $4.552 (Friday May 22 close; AAA publishes no fresh daily survey over the weekend through Monday May 25 Memorial Day holiday). +52.2% above $2.99 Feb 28 baseline; ~$1.38/gal above year-ago levels; just 9¢ below the June 2022 all-time record of $4.61. AAA's holiday-travel survey (released May 11, attributed to Stacey Barber, VP AAA Travel) projected a RECORD 45M Americans travelling ≥50 miles over the long weekend (39.1M by car, 3.66M by air) — held up despite the highest pre-Memorial Day pump prices since 2022. California highest at $6.111; Washington ~$5.78; Hawaii ~$5.64; Indiana cheapest at $3.933. Patrick De Haan (GasBuddy) attributes 'more than 90%' of the YoY increase directly to the Iran war. CNN/SSRS poll (April 30–May 4, n=1,499, ±2.8pp; CNN Politics May 12): 21% approve Trump on gas prices, 75% say the Iran war has had a negative effect on their finances, 77% say his policies have increased their local cost of living. Watson Institute / Costs of War (Brown — Jeff Colgan, May 2026): cumulative extra fuel costs to U.S. consumers since war start now top $40 billion, more than $300 per household. Asian futures opened sharply lower late Sunday May 24 (Brent intraday low ~$98.12, -5.2%; WTI ~$92) on Trump's 'largely negotiated' Truth Social post — Trump economic adviser Kevin Hassett on Fox News Sunday: 'We expect energy prices, as soon as there's a deal, to plummet.' Pump-price relief, if a deal lands, runs 2-3 weeks behind crude per De Haan. Trump 05-11 federal gas-tax suspension (18.4¢) still in legislative pipeline; no enactment through 05-24.
